text: ORG TIME announced an across-the-board increase of PERCENT in steel mill products. resulting in a price increase exceeding MONEY to the NORP consumer, --setting back the efforts of all NORP to reverse the current inflationary trend and get back on the road to price stability, --creating pressures for price increases across the whole range of products that are made out of steel, --eroding our world competitive position and jeopardizing our balance of payments, and --aggravating the steel industry's own problems in meeting competition from foreign producers and substitute materials. Steel prices have been moving gradually upward on a selective basis. I stated DATE, and I quote, The relative stability of steel prices has been one of the key favorable factors in our recent price record, and it must be preserved. The steel companies and the union reached a collective bargaining agreement DATE. The terms of their settlement are high. That settlement will result in some increases in steel costs, but the announced ORG price increase far exceeds any reasonable calculation of the cost of the wage settlement. Steel is the Nation's basic industrial product and the industry's pricing decisions affect our entire economy. Inflation in steel is inflation for the ORG. NORP consumers are now threatened by a price increase that will take MONEY a year directly out of their pockets and pocketbooks and at the very time they are paying increased taxes as their contribution to the urgent task of restoring price stability. According to the ticker TIME, ORG, with sales buoyed by DATE hedged buying against a strike that never came, DATE reported net profits of $MONEY for DATE, a PERCENT increase over DATE. The public interest must be recognized by the entire steel industry in its price decisions at this critical time. I spoke on this general subject to ORG, as some of you may remember, that met at Hot Springs back on DATE. I believe at the ranch on DATE, I had another statement to make on it for your reference.1 ORG made reference to it in a release to you in DATE. Those statements are available to you through ORG if you care to take them. We are reserving the MONEY for impacted school aid that the ORG added to the second DATE supplemental bill over and above our budget.

text: These funds are in addition to those requested by the administration and they will add to DATE budget expenditures. Both the ORG and ORG have also added another MONEY to the DATE request for impacted school aid. Therefore, these CARDINAL items will add MONEY to the DATE budget over and above that requested. In other words, the ORG in CARDINAL breath says you must cut MONEY from your budget as you send it to ORG, and while doing that, we add another MONEY over and above that budget. text: It is a great honor to be with you TIME. Let me just begin by expressing special thanks to Governors PERSON and PERSON, chairman and vice chairman of the ORG , PERSON, the finance chairman and vice chairman of the-or PERSON, I should say, who is exceptional efforts have helped to make TIME a success. And of course, I must also recognize our national chairman, PERSON, who is here. You know, whenever I am asked to speak at a dinner, I get a little self-conscious about the length of a speech. And this is really inappropriate, but I am going to tell it anyway. I hope you have not heard it before, because usually I am an after-dinner speaker instead of a before-dinner speaker. But the joke that I was going to tell you was a little story that took place in ancient GPE at the FAC. A little band of NORP out there in the sand on the floor of the FAC, crowd up there in the seats, and then they were going to turn the lions loose on them. And the lions came roaring out and charging down on this little huddled mass of people. And one of them stepped forward and said a few quiet words, and the lion stopped and laid down. Well, the crowd was enraged that they were not going to get the show that they'd expected. PERSON was so mad that he had them bring the man to him, and he said, What did you say that made the lions act like that? He said, I just told them that after they ate there would be speeches. As CARDINAL chief executive among many, I feel right at home. I have always said one of the greatest strengths of GPE is the diversity of our Federal system. As we have begun to loosen the bonds of centralized control, the ORG have shot forward, often showing ORG the way. The NORP people now look to ORG as the party of new ideas. And it is NORP Governors who are out front, taking risks, breaking new ground, putting those new ideas into practice-everything from enterprise zones to welfare reform. Yes, we thought of the enterprise zone. We have not been able to get it through the ORG. But I do not know how many NORP now around the country have enterprise zones, and they are flourishing and succeeding in their mission. Is not it about time that GPE followed the lead of the GPE and passed a constitutional amendment to balance the budget?

text: the lineitem veto. I remember CARDINAL new idea I had when I was Governor. It taught me a lot about leadership and its limits. When I first came into the Governor's mansion, I thought it would be a great way to improve efficiency if I asked everybody to work DATE a month-on DATE. I cannot claim a lot of success with that one. But the best thing about this dinner is seeing how the ranks of NORP Governors have grown since DATE. We are talking about a PERCENT increase-from CARDINAL to CARDINAL Governors. And we are looking to add to that number in the elections DATE, with PERSON running in GPE, PERSON in GPE, and PERSON in GPE. But the critical test will come in DATE. We have CARDINAL gubernatorial races DATE. Of these, CARDINAL are seats that we have to hold on to and CARDINAL then that we have to win. Few races could be more important, few campaigns more crucial, to the future of our country. What happens in those elections will have repercussions that extend far beyond the State capitals and far beyond State lines-all the way, in fact, to GPE, GPE, and ORG on ORG. That is because reapportionment comes up in DATE. And in all too many cases, having a NORP Governor is the only shot we have at getting a fair deal. an end to the antidemocratic and NORP practice of gerrymandering congressional districts. In the races, NORP won CARDINAL more votes than the NORP, but ORG won CARDINAL more seats. In GPE, CARDINAL of the worst cases of gerrymandering in the country, NORP received a majority of votes in congressional races, but the NORP won PERCENT more races. The NORP-controlled State legislatures have so rigged the electoral process that the will of the people cannot be heard. They vote NORP but elect NORP. A look at the district lines shows how corrupt the whole process has become. The congressional map is a horror show of grotesque, contorted shapes. Districts jump back and forth over mountain ranges, cross large bodies of water, send out little tentacles to absorb special communities and ensure safe seats. CARDINAL NORP Congressman who helped engineer the gerrymandering of GPE once described the district lines there as his contribution to modern art. it is the NORP values of fair play and decency. And it is time we stopped them.

text: PERSON and ORG have challenged the NORP' gerrymandering in court, but ultimately it is in the State legislatures that the battle for fairness must be won. And that is why we need more NORP Governors to oversee the process and why NORP have to campaign with all heart and soul for NORP State legislative candidates. As far as the ENTITY is concerned, he is not going to be sitting around FAC in DATE. I am going to be out on the campaign trail, telling the NORP people the truth about how the electoral process has been twisted and distorted, that it is time to give the votes back to the people. Vote NORP in DATE. The fact is democratic gerrymandering is just CARDINAL symptom of a larger problem. We have seen a dimension of this problem DATE on the ORG during the debate over the confirmation of Judge PERSON to ORG. During the hearings, Attorney General PERSON spoke for many of us when he expressed his shock and dismay. I have never seen such misrepresentation, such distortion, and such outright lying. There are people in very important positions in this government who are lying to the NORP public. I have never seen anything like it, and I hope I never see anything like it again. But former Attorney General PERSON is not alone in his opinion. CARDINAL of the most respected, honorable men in this nation, Chief Justice PERSON, echoed this when he accused the opposition to Judge PERSON of disinformation. Judge PERSON's nomination will soon be before the full ORG. The purpose of ORG debate is to allow all sides to be heard. Honorable men and women should not be afraid to change their minds if they are based on that debate. It will call into question the idea of free, fair, and civil exchange. And it will mean that on critical issues, like the fight against crime and drugs and keeping those who are unelected from unconstitutionally taking power into their own hands-each of us and each of our children will be the losers. I do not believe that nominees to ORG should have to pass litmus tests administered by single-interest lobbies. Such tactics are better suited for campaigns and elections than for ORG nominations. Our agenda is quite simple-to appoint judges who do not confuse the criminals with the victims and who believe the courts should interpret the law, not make it. That starts with ORG.
label: monologic

text: It takes leadership from ORG to help shape the attitudes of the courts in our land and to make sure that principles of law are based on the Constitution. This is the standard to judge those who seek to serve on the courts-qualifications, not distortions; judicial temperament, not campaign disinformation. The process of confirming Justices for our nation's highest court has been transformed in a way that should not and, indeed, must not be permitted to occur again. And, yes, people can have different opinions. But when have we ever seen an instance in which the confirmation of a Justice to ORG has resulted in private interest groups raising money and putting on television ads and campaigns as if they were running an election-and campaigns based on distortion-when the men and women of the ORG are supposed to sit, go over the qualifications of the individual that has been appointed, and make their decision on whether they believe those qualifications suit him for the position. Well, that is what we have to get back to. When the message gets out, I believe the NORP people will reject the politicization of our judiciary. When the people begin to hear the truth, they will demand an independent judiciary, free from high pressure politics and founded on the principle of judicial restraint. And Judge PERSON is a man of courage. He is decided to push forward, to take the vote on his confirmation to the full ORG. And he is going forward because he knows that the wrong done him is nothing compared to the wrong done to our nation and our system of justice. PERSON deserves better. GPE deserves better. I cannot conclude without talking again about an issue that I found so many people are unaware of, and that is getting back to this gerrymandering that has taken place. From DATE-DATE-CARDINAL Presidents had a NORP ORG-both ORG and ORG. Each one of them only had it for DATE. CARDINAL was a NORP President, PERSON, for CARDINAL of DATE, and the other one was PERSON, who had a NORP ORG for CARDINAL out of his DATE. But for CARDINAL out of those CARDINAL years, the opposition party had both ORG of the ORG. In these, going on DATE that I have been here, I did have CARDINAL ORG for DATE, the ORG, and ORG continued to be in the other party's hands.

text: And now for DATE, we are back to having them, once again, in control in both ORG. You have people on CARDINAL side out there in the legislature, then people on the other side in ORG. That is not what the checks and balances were supposed to be. And certainly, when every NORP President in DATE, with the exception of CARDINAL DATE period, had a ORG of their own party, and then when the NORP had a ORG of the other party for everything but DATE-all NORP Presidents until my term with having at least one party for a while-the significant thing is we can look back from the inside, where we are in our administration, and tell you that none of the things we have accomplished could have been accomplished had we not had that CARDINAL NORP ORG, the ORG, for DATE. And now we are back to the regular way of doing things if they continue to have their way. And it all stems out there in the GPE, their legislators and their Governors, where the redistricting takes place. I saw it firsthand, because when I was Governor of GPE, CARDINAL of the years for redistricting came up. And I vetoed what they came up with. And we finally ended turning it over to ORG. But they'd been in power so long that I did not even have ORG on my side. But it is so wonderful for all of you to gather here and to do what you are doing. And I know that I have to let you have your dinner and get out of here. I really was just standing here, hoping that I could think of a good get-off line. But it has been wonderful, and you have got some great Governors here. And this country's strength is based not on what is inside the beltway here in GPE, it is based on the fact that we are a federation of CARDINAL sovereign States with a great independence. And one of the things that I will be the happiest about is that CARDINAL of my goals has been, ever since I came here, to restore the Federal system and return to the GPE the authority and autonomy that has been unjustly seized by ORG in DATE that have gone past. And let us get back to those CARDINAL different GPE. Thank you all very much, and God bless you.

text: Businesses and families cannot get credit, and small businesses cannot secure the loans they need to create jobs and get their products to market. Now is the time for GPE to act with the same sense of urgency that NORP all across the country feel DATE. With the stakes this high, we cannot afford to get trapped in the same old partisan gridlock. That is why I have worked closely with leaders of both parties on a recovery and reinvestment plan that saves or creates CARDINAL jobs over DATE, cuts taxes for PERCENT of NORP workers, and makes critical investments in our future--in energy and education, health care, and a DATE infrastructure. The vast majority of the investments in the plan will be made within DATE, immediately creating jobs and helping ORG avoid painful tax hikes and cuts to essential services. And every dime of the spending will be made available to the public on recovery.gov, so every NORP can see where their tax dollars are going. But as we act boldly and swiftly to shore up our financial system and revitalize our economy, we must also make sure that the underpinnings of that economy are sound; that our economic infrastructure is rebuilt to handle the traffic of the global economy; that our cutting-edge science and technology remain the envy of the world; that our policies promote the innovative and competitive nature of this economy and facilitate the incubation and commercialization of our startups and small businesses, the very engine of our job creation. These are the tasks of ORG. And I believe that PERSON is the right person to help guide the ORG towards these goals. PERSON discovered the family business at an early age. His father, PERSON, was elected the youngest Governor of GPE when judge--PERSON was a boy. At a time when the mills in GPE closed down and folks were laid off, he watched his dad work tirelessly to attract new industry, the kind that created jobs that carried with them a sense of dignity and self-worth. PERSON's father even found the time to publish a book titled All I Learned About Politics, and in keeping with his legendary sense of humor, all of its pages were blank. When the book is written about PERSON, it will tell the story of a man with his own proud record of service on behalf of the NORP people.

text: As a businessman, attorney, State executive councilor, Congressman, Governor in his own right, and now as a Senator, he is seen from all angles what makes our economy work for communities, businesses, and families, and what keeps it from working better. As former chairman of ORG and ORG, PERSON has been involved in nearly every facet of public policy. And as ORG chair on ORG, he is already quite familiar with the ORG I have chosen him to lead. PERSON is famous--or infamous, depending on your perspective--on ORG for his strict fiscal discipline. It is not that he enjoys saying no, although if it is directed at your bill, you might feel that way. It is that he shares my deep-seated commitment to guaranteeing that our children inherit a future they can afford. Now, clearly, PERSON and I do not agree on every issue; most notably who should have won the election. But we agree on the urgent need to get NORP businesses and families back on their feet. We see eye to eye on conducting the Nation's business in a responsible, transparent, and accountable manner. And we know the only way to solve the great challenges of our time is to put aside stale ideology and petty partisanship and embrace what works. As one of ORG most respected voices and skillful negotiators, PERSON is a master of reaching across the aisle to get things done. He will be an outstanding addition to the depth and experience of my economic team, a trusted voice in my ORG, and an able and persuasive ambassador for industry who makes it known to the world that GPE is open for business. ORG defies every wind, overrides every tempest, and invades every zone. These are the words carved into the walls of the ORG that I am so pleased PERSON has agreed to lead. text: On DATE TIME I will present my plan to generate jobs and increase the incomes of the NORP people. text: GPE lies between CARDINAL great oceans, the Atlantic and the Pacific. We are a nation of the Atlantic by birth, but our ties to the Asia-Pacific region deepen DATE. text: The crime rate is down in almost every State in GPE, in no small measure because people are out there in uniform, walking the streets in the communities, doing what they can to help prevent crime. More and more law enforcement officers are in our schools through programs like the D.A.R.E. program, trying to help educate children and prevent the drug problem from taking hold. CARDINAL strikes and you are out is now the law of the land, and more and more career criminals are being tried under it and convicted under it. We are taking steps against the terrible problems of violence against women. And the crime bill, together with the education bills that were passed in our budget, have increased our commitment to drug treatment as well as to education and other prevention strategies, which is also important. If you think about what your ORG does directly- well, we do the national defense directly. We do some law enforcement directly. We do some things directly through the mail, the ORG checks, the ORG checks. But a lot of what we do-in the form of education, in the form of protecting the environment, in the form of promoting law enforcement and safe streets, in the form of growing the economy-a lot of what we do, we do in partnership with individuals at the community level. And we have tried to focus on that very sharply. So we have tried to bring down the size of the ORG bureaucracy but to increase the commitment of ORG at the grassroots level so you could do what needs to be done. We know that for the first time in a long time, as I said, the crime rate is down. In addition to the crime rate being down, you might be interested to know that over DATE, the welfare rolls are down, the food stamp rolls are down, the teen pregnancy rate has come down DATE, and the poverty rate is down. Child support payments are up PERCENT, and the college loan delinquency rate is down by PERCENT. Having said that, we know that crime, welfare, poverty, violence, and drug abuse are still far too high. text: And there is still way too much violence in this country, as the tragic example of the PERSON family shows. But PERSON knows that this will create opportunity for all NORP, and he believes in keeping GPE strong to keep GPE free and at peace. I need PERSON, GPE needs PERSON, and so does GPE need PERSON. PERSON is running for the ORG, and I have to tell you he is one of the finest candidates I have ever known. PERSON believes, with me, that we can save you MONEY by cutting government waste and fraud, and that is what is the principal difference between him and his opponent, the present incumbent. And PERSON, PERSON, and congressional candidate PERSON are all determined to help us keep your taxes down. So, if you do not mind, I am going to ask a favor. If you plan to vote for our ticket, please vote for our entire ticket. Help spread the word, get out the vote, and do you mind if I say, Win 'em for the Gipper ?

text: You know, I remember that line that he spoke when he made that request, the Gipper, and he said, Wherever I am, I will know about it, and it'll make me happy. But if you do, we will keep building our new future of opportunities for GPE. You know, PERSON said that we must disenthrall ourselves with the past and then we will save our country. And DATE, that is what we did. We made a great turn, we got out from under the thrall of a government which we had hoped would make our lives better, but which wound up living our lives for us. DATE we began to navigate by certain fixed principles. We knew that economic freedom meant paying less of the NORP family's earnings to the Government, and so we cut personal tax rates by PERCENT across the board. We knew that inflation, the quiet thief, that thief was stealing, along with record interest rates, stealing your future. We knew that our national military defense had been weakened, so we decided to rebuild and be strong again to be prepared for peace. But GPE is back, a giant on the scene, powerful in its renewed spirit, powerful in its growing economy, and powerful in its ability to defend itself and secure the peace. And do you know something? Yet DATE after our efforts began, small voices in TIME are sounding the call to go back, to go back to DATE of drift, DATE of torpor, timidity, and taxes. My opponent's understanding of economics is well demonstrated by his predictions. Just before we took office, he said that our economic program was obviously, murderously inflationary. And just a short time later we brought inflation down from PERCENT to PERCENT. And just after our tax cuts, he said the most that he could see was an anemic recovery. And that was just before GPE economy created CARDINAL new jobs in DATE. My opponent said that decontrolling oil prices would cost you, the NORP consumers, MONEY. Well, CARDINAL of the first things we did was eliminate the control of oil prices, and the price of gasoline went down MONEY a gallon. I have got it figured out that all we have to do to get our economy in absolutely perfect shape is persuade him to predict absolute disaster.

text: He says he cares about the middle class, but he boasts, I have consistently supported legislation, time after time, which increases taxes on my own constituents. Does not that make you want to be one of his constituents again? He is no doubt proud of the fact that as a GPE Senator he voted CARDINAL times to raise your taxes. He is already promised, of course, to raise your taxes. But if he is to keep all the promises that he is made, he will have to raise taxes the equivalent of $MONEY for every household in GPE. That is like having a second mortgage, a PERSON mortgage. CARDINAL, raise taxes; CARDINAL, raise them again. The NORP people do not want his tax increases, and he is not going to get his tax increases. His tax plan would bring our recovery to a roaring stop. You know, if my opponent's campaign plan were a TV show, it would be Let us Make a Deal. You trade your prosperity for his surprise that is hidden behind the curtain. And if it were a book, you'd have to read it from the back to the front to get a happy ending. He sees DATE in which DATE is DATE DATE. Well, we see an GPE in which DATE is DATE DATE. We want to lower your taxes some more. We want to do it for everybody in this country so your families will be stronger, the economy will be stronger, and GPE will be stronger. On another subject, I am proud to say that during DATE, not QUANTITY of territory in the world has been lost to NORP aggression. But my opponent sees a different world. After the NORP invaded GPE, he said, It just baffles me why the NORP DATE have behaved as they have. But then, there is so much that baffles him. DATE we liberated GPE from NORP thugs who had taken over that country. And my opponent called what we did a violation of international law that erodes our moral authority to criticize the NORP. There is nothing immoral about rescuing NORP students whose lives were in danger. But you know, let me try to put this all in perspective. I was a NORP once, and for a large part of my life.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks at a Reagan-Bush Rally in Saginaw, Michigan

text: I am sure there are many NORP present; I hope so, because I know that all across this country are CARDINAL of patriotic NORP who have found they can no longer follow the policies of the leadership of ORG DATE. In those days when I was a NORP, the leaders of ORG were not members of that blame GPE first crowd. It is leaders were men like PERSON and, later, men like Senator PERSON and PERSON men who understood the challenges of the times. They did not reserve all their indignation for GPE. They knew the difference between freedom and tyranny, and they stood up for one and damned the other. To all the good NORP who respect that tradition of their party, I say, You are not alone. We are asking you to come walk down the path of hope and opportunity with the rest of us, and in a bipartisan way a solid tradition of this country we will keep GPE prosperous and free and at peace. DATE an NORP woman walked in space PERSON made history. And then she returned to a shuttle, a space shuttle, in which some of the great scientific and medical advances of the future will be made. Cures for diabetes and heart disease may be possible up there indeed, I have seen evidence of that from some of the experiments conducted already. But my opponent led the fight against the whole shuttle system. He called it a horrible waste. Well, we support the space shuttle, and we have committed GPE to meet a great challenge to build a permanently manned space station and to do it within DATE. What GPE needs is high tech, not high taxes. But the point is, we were right when we made that great turn in DATE. We were right to take command of the ship, to stop its aimless drift, and to get moving again. And we were right when we stopped sending out GPE and started saying GPE! GPE was never meant to be a second-best nation. Like our Olympic athletes, this nation should set its sights on the stars and go for the gold. You know, if GPE could bring down inflation from PERCENT to CARDINAL, as we did, then we can bring it down from CARDINAL to CARDINAL, and we are going to do that. If lowering your tax rates led to the best expansion in DATE, then we can lower them again and keep GPE growing right into DATE.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks at a Reagan-Bush Rally in Saginaw, Michigan

text: If we could create those CARDINAL new jobs in DATE, then we can make it possible for every NORP young and old, black or white who wants a job to find a job. And if local governments around this country can establish enterprise zones to create economic growth, then we can elect people to the ORG who will free our national enterprise zones bill. This is a bill to go into the distressed areas of some of our rural areas and our major city areas and, through tax incentives, establish industry and work there that will give jobs to people that presently do not have them. Well, that bill has been buried in a committee of the ORG for DATE now. And if we get the right people back there in the ORG, they will break it out, and we will have this bill that will mean hope for CARDINAL in the most distressed areas of GPE. We are leading a revolution in technology and pushing back the frontiers of space. And if we give NORP workers the tools they need in industries, old and new, then I think that NORP workers with the proper tools can outcompete, outsell, outproduce anyone, anytime, anywhere in the world. Our drive in DATE or so to restore excellence in education has reversed a DATE decline in the scholastic aptitude test scores. And we are going to keep raising those scores and restore NORP academic excellence second to none. Our crackdown on crime produced the sharpest drop ever in the crime index. And we are going to keep cracking down until your families and friends can walk on the streets at TIME without being afraid. We have reversed the decline in our military defenses and restored respect for GPE. And we are going to keep this nation strong to protect freedom and peace for us, for our children, and for our children's children. And if we make sure that GPE remains strong and prepared for peace, then we can begin to reduce nuclear weapons and one day banish them entirely from the face of the Earth. And as we strengthen our economy, strengthen our security, and strengthen the values that bind us, GPE will become a nation even greater in art and learning and greater in the love and worship of the God that made us and that has blessed us more than any other people on this Earth have ever been blessed. Now, I ran out of time DATE on the debate, and I did not get to finish something I started to say there. Well I am going to say it now.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks at a Reagan-Bush Rally in Saginaw, Michigan

text: And it is to the young people of our country who are here with us DATE. You, you are what this election is all about you and your future. I have been seeing these young people all across the country on campuses, in schools, in rallies of this kind. And I have to tell you, this generation of young people really sparkles. Your idealism, your love of country are unsurpassed. And I want to tell you that my generation and a few generations between mine and yours -we have a sacred trust. And that is, when the time comes to turn over the reins to you, you young people out there, we are going to turn over to you an GPE that is every bit as full of opportunity, hope, confidence, and dreams as it was when we were your age and growing up in GPE. We are going to turn over to you an GPE that is free in a world that is at peace. We were born to be a special place between the CARDINAL great oceans with a unique mission to carry freedom's torch. To a tired, disillusioned world we have always been a light of hope where all things are possible. And throughout my life I have seen GPE do the impossible. We survived a Great Depression that toppled governments in many parts of the world. We came back from FAC to win the greatest military victory in world history. And in a single lifetime in my lifetime we have gone from the horse and buggy to landing astronauts on the Moon. We NORP have fought harder, paid a higher price, done more to advance the freedom and dignity of man, than any other people who ever lived on this Earth. Ours is the land of the free because it is the home of the brave. And our people will be free because we are united CARDINAL people, under God, with liberty and justice for all. I am deeply honored that you have let me serve you for DATE. We must continue to build upon the new beginning that we started DATE. So I have come here DATE to ask for your support and for your vote. But now, I have gotten a little frightened reading the polls, and I will tell you why. I have a terrible feeling that some may decide their votes are not needed. Go to the polls, vote. And I will tell you, if you are going to vote for me, as you have just indicated, do not send me back there alone. You ain't seen nothin' yet.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks at a Reagan-Bush Rally in Saginaw, Michigan

text: Ladies and gentlemen, before we adjourn to the reception in honor of Justice PERSON, I'd like to acknowledge the presence here DATE of Senator PERSON, who sponsored her so strongly in the ORG, Senator PERSON of GPE, Senator PERSON of GPE, and the chairman of ORG, my good friend PERSON from GPE. It is good to see all of you here. This was a very important appointment to me. In one of my former lives I had the great joy and responsibility of teaching the United States Constitution and the decisions of ORG under it to aspiring but not always interested law students. We breathe life into the values we espouse through our law. It gives to every NORP, including the most illiterate among us, the most totally unaware of how the legal system works, a fair measure of our ideals and some reality that comes into life from the speeches given by the rest of us. This is a moment, this historic moment, therefore, that all NORP can celebrate. For no one knows better than she that it is the law that provides the rules that permit us to live together and that permit us to overcome the infirmities, the bigotry, the prejudice, the limitations of our past and our present. Her nearly unanimous confirmation by ORG was the swiftest in DATE. Much credit must go to her own brilliance and her thoughtful, balanced reasoning. But I thank Senators PERSON and PERSON for their sponsorship and assistance. I thank Chairman PERSON and Senator PERSON for their contributions and all the other Senators, including those here present, who supported her. PERSON does not need a seat on ORG to earn a place in our history books. She has already secured that. As a brilliant young law school graduate she became an early victim of gender discrimination when as a woman and mother she sought nothing more than that which every one of us wants, a chance to do her work. She met this challenge with character and determination. She took on the complex challenges of winning what seems now to be such a terribly simple principle, equal treatment for women and men before the law. Virtually every significant case brought before ORG in DATE on behalf of women bore her mark. DATE, virtually no segment of our society has been untouched by her efforts.

text: It is a privilege DATE to be the guest of ORG, and it is a great personal pleasure to which I have looked forward for DATE. Here DATE, in this beautiful city of GPE, there was born a new era of friendship and confidence among the Americas. No one is entitled to more credit for DATE than Your Excellency, for you labored unceasingly and generously both as host and as statesman for the success of that conference. I believe that when history comes to be written, the origin of the new NORP era will be placed here in DATE. Truly, it is an inspiration for the average citizen of all our NORP that that conference is giving back its fruits in terms of achievement for the people of the world. During DATE I have become certain of this because I have seen in the faces of the men, women, and children in GPE, in GPE, and, DATE, in GPE a joyful expression of hope and faith which can and will inspire us, their chosen representatives, to even greater activity in the common cause. You, Mr. President, have used a term in speaking of that great patriot, General PERSON, which can well be the inspiration of us all. You have spoken of his serene and noble spirit of applied justice. It is because of this spirit which actuated the founding fathers of ORG that we their followers are inspired to maintain the democratic principles for which they fought. I am particularly grateful for the kind words which you, Mr. President, have spoken concerning our policies in GPE. We fully join with you in the thought that the first battlefield of peace is that of securing well-being at home. It has been of special interest to me to know that you in GPE have made such great advances in behalf of the well-being of your citizens. In DATE of General PERSON and of his friend President PERSON, human society had, of course, little conception of the economic and social problems which we face DATE. None of the fathers of any of our NORP had even heard of DATE, of minimum wages, of protection for women and children, of collective bargaining between employers and employees, of old-age security, of modern sanitation, of concrete highways, of railroads or steel buildings. The fathers had no thought of the telegraph, the radio, the automobile, or of travel by fast steamships and by air.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Address at Montevideo, Uruguay.

text: They knew little of the problems of modern science, of modern finance. And yet, you and I are very certain that if they were alive DATE the founders of our Governments would look with approval on what we are seeking to do to use the processes of democratic government in solving the new problems. I recognize, as you do, that these new problems are common to all our ORG. I am glad that you have said that we have been compelled to abandon the comfortable attitude of statesmen of the old school. Every Nation in all the world has been compelled to recognize the fact of new conditions. It is of the utmost importance that ORG have found it possible under vigorous leadership to find the answer within the spirit and the framework of constitutional government and democratic processes. We have not completed our task. In accordance with the objectives and theory of democratic government, that task is a continuing one. sometimes the remedies succeed, and sometimes they must be altered or improved. We learn, and ought to learn, much from each other-much that is good and some things which, from experience, we must avoid. In the case of agriculture, for example, you are familiar with the fact that in GPE we did many things in the past which ran counter to the laws of nature and of sensible economics. In many parts of my country we have used land in such a way as to diminish its productiveness, we have harmed our supply of water, and we have lost our topsoil. Today our Government seeks to work with our farming population in correcting these mistakes and in bringing back a greater prosperity and a more permanent use of the land. I cite this as an example, which you undoubtedly know of, to show the need among all our GPE of keeping in close touch with each other, for many of our problems are similar. On this delightful visit to GPE, GPE, and GPE I have been impressed with the immediate need for better and quicker services of travel and communication between North and South America. I look forward to DATE when, instead of the journey being long and unusual, visits between ORG and those of Central America and of North America will be so usual and simple that CARDINAL of our citizens will meet each other in friendly intercourse DATE. And may I add that I hope that we shall have a much greater familiarity with each other's language.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Address at Montevideo, Uruguay.

text: I appreciate it most highly. I remember how cordial you were when I came here in DATE, and I shall never forget it. I think I told you then about how my grandfather came out here with an ox train load of merchandise, and how PERSON helped him out. And since that time the records have been examined and the church files show that it actually happened just as I told it. He had the first train of his own loaded with merchandise for the ENTITY, and when he got here the colonel in charge of the post had another freighter that he wanted to hold and he would not accept my grandfather's load of goods. And it almost broke him, and if it had not been for PERSON it would have broke him--but they worked it out and everybody was happy except the colonel in charge of the post. I have been making this trip to campaign for ORG. I am happy to do that, because I think you suspect by this time that I am a good NORP. I believe with all my heart that it is in the best interests of the country for the NORP to win this election. I think we are going to win it. We are going to win on the basis of our record, our platform, and our candidates. On each of these things, when you compare the NORP situation with the NORP situation, the NORP look so much better that there is no difficulty whatever to make a choice. ORG has been giving the country good government for DATE. At home the country is in better shape than it ever has been. Abroad, we are making good progress in building up our defenses against the terrible threat of NORP aggression. At home and abroad, ORG has been against almost every forward-looking proposal that we have made in DATE. Now they are trying to rewrite history, but I am not going to let them get away with it. I have been reading the record on them, and I am going to keep it up, and tell the people exactly what the facts are. You see, nearly every place I go, somebody in the crowd around the street will let out a yell Give 'em hell, PERSON. Well now, I do not strive for a reputation of that kind. I tell the truth on them, and that is a lot better for the country than giving them hell, because they cannot stand the truth. I hope every one of you will have an opportunity to read the NORP platform, and the NORP platform, too.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Rear Platform Remarks in Utah and Colorado

text: They will show you what the difference is between the CARDINAL parties. I think we have the best platform any political party ever adopted, and think the NORP platform is about the worst one I ever read. Along with everything else they even endorsed that do-nothing 80th ORG. You remember it? TIME, I told ORG that I was going to call a special session of ORG and see whether the NORP in the 80th ORG would put their platform into effect. Oh, they had a platform that was intended to appeal to everybody in the country, so I called them together and they met for DATE and did not do a thing. I knew that was exactly what they would do--because they never do expect to carry out a platform even when it is good, but this one is so bad they cannot carry it out. If they were to win this election, you could count on them giving you the same sort of treatment you had from that 80th ORG-which won the election in DATE for me. I told you when I was here in DATE what the NORP had been trying to do to your reclamation and power programs. They have been trying to do the same ever since-and you cannot trust them. The NORP have it all over the NORP in the case of candidates--just like we do everything else. And I do not know of any place where that is clearer than it is here in GPE. You have a fine NORP candidate here for GPE Senator--PERSON. PERSON has made a wonderful record in ORG, and if you will send him to the ORG, you will have somebody there who will look out for your interests. Now I have known Mr. PERSON for I do not know how long--15 or DATE-and he has always been on the side of the people. You need a man like that in the ORG worse than ever now--I will say you need him from this State. For ORG you have Mrs. PERSON. Judge PERSON has also made a grand record in ORG. This is especially true on reclamation matters. If you send her back to ORG, and send PERSON to the ORG, you will have a very effective team to work for you on the reclamation projects that mean so much to this great western country. I also hope very much that you will promote your mayor, PERSON, to be Governor of this great State of GPE.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Rear Platform Remarks in Utah and Colorado

text: I hope you will also send that good NORP that was just introduced to you, Mr. PERSON, to ORG. He impresses me as being a wonderful man. The best thing, you know, for your own safety, is to just vote the NORP ticket and send them all in. I urge you most strongly to vote for our candidate for President and Vice PresidentPERSON and PERSON. I think it would be a tragedy for the present NORP candidate to be elected President of GPE. He has been a great general, but he has already shown in this campaign that he cannot be depended on to master the great political issues with which we are faced. He has surrendered to the most reactionary elements of ORG. He is not the kind of man we ought to have for President. Now I like him. I made him Chief of Staff of the GPE ENTITY. I sent him to Europe to command the ORG military setup, and I have every confidence in him as a military man. But as President and politician, he would not know what to do. Now, on the other hand, I am more than ever impressed DATE with what PERSON offers to the ORG. He is talking sense to the NORP people. And he will not be taken in by any special interest lobby. If you elect him and a NORP ORG, the country will be safe for DATE. Again I want to thank you very much for this most cordial welcome. I appreciate that greeting very, very much. I am glad to be back here in GPE once more. I was here in DATE and gave you some down to earth facts about that good for-nothing, do-nothing NORP 80th ORG, if you remember. Then you did your duty at the polls, and I want to congratulate you on the way you voted. I understand GPE had the best record of any county in GPE in the vote you gave ORG in DATE. And I hope you will repeat that again. I am sure you will do it over in DATE, and send PERSON to ORG. I have always been interested in the way your good town got its name. They tell me that FAC was named for the helper engines that pull the train up these wonderful mountains you have around here. You know, I think ORG needs some helper engines.

metadata.title: Rear Platform Remarks in Utah and Colorado

text: It would take a whole roundhouse full of these helpers to get them elected DATE, with their terrible record holding them back. As for their candidate for President, I do not think helper engines can get him out of the trouble he is in now. With the crew he has got around him, I do not think he will ever be elected. I just do not think the people are going to elect a President who has surrendered to PERSON and PERSON and PERSON and PERSON. I am glad to come to your GPE and tell you that I am proud of the NORP candidate for GPE Senator. GPE has a wonderful man in PERSON. He has been one of the best Members of ORG for DATE, and I know he is going to make a great GPE Senator. Your candidate for ORG, Mr. PERSON, knows the importance of using our national resources for the benefit of all the people, instead of just the special interests. I met Mr. PERSON TIME, the present mayor of GPE--he was there to welcome me, and I understand he is going to be the next Governor of GPE. Now when you vote for President and Vice President, remember that this country has never had CARDINAL better candidates than PERSON and PERSON. They have shown by their record that they stand for the interests of the common everyday man. I want to tell you this, too. They are telling the truth in this campaign. They are not like some NORP politicians who are running around distorting the facts and trying to rewrite history. You can count on PERSON and PERSON to continue the prosperity you now have. You people here in Price Canyon area know the importance of steady employment. DATE, when the NORP people voted the NORP out of office, there were CARDINAL people out of work in this country. But DATE our country is working full blast, with CARDINAL people in good jobs. I told the students up at ORG in GPE TIME that in DATE when they were graduating, they did not know where to go for jobs. There were CARDINAL people out of jobs, and the graduates of that university would be lucky if they got a job at MONEY a day.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Rear Platform Remarks in Utah and Colorado

text: And then I read them an extract from a piece in ORG about the graduation of DATE from colleges, in which it was said the students now have so many jobs to pick from, they do not know which one to take. Now I think you had better keep up that situation. And the reason you can do that is because ORG has courage. This thing did not come about by accident. ORG has had the courage, the wisdom, and the faith to make our economy work in a way that all NORP, not just a special few, could enjoy prosperity and full employment. Our policy is for the people. ORG policy is the welfare and benefit of all the people, not just a few. Compare the terrible NORP record and the terrible NORP platform DATE with the NORP record and with the NORP platform DATE, and you cannot possibly go wrong because you will vote the NORP ticket. You will only come to CARDINAL conclusion. Vote your own interests--that is what you are doing. You see, the power of the Government in this country is in the people, and the people exercise that power by voting. You go to the polls and vote for your own interests--vote for the welfare of this great Nation, and vote for peace in the world, by voting the NORP ticket, and the country will be safe for DATE. I appreciate it very much--very much indeed this introduction, and I am particularly happy over that synthetic truth brigade that is supposed to be following me. You know, I was shadowed in DATE by somebody, and now I am being shadowed again. We are telling the truth on them, and that really hurts. I am here in one of my many jobs--campaigning as a leader of ORG. It is good to come to a NORP place like this. You gave me a good big majority in DATE. You have been NORP since DATE. You have a good NORP representing you in ORG--PERSON. Awhile ago when I heard your national committeeman introduce PERSON, I did not know who he was talking about. I know him as PERSON, and I think he is all right, and he will make you a good Governor. I have known him a long, long time. PERSON is a go-getter, and he will be an asset to GPE and to you. Now I want to call your attention particularly to our candidates for President and Vice President.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Rear Platform Remarks in Utah and Colorado

text: I do not think that we have ever had abler men to head the NORP ticket than we have in PERSON and PERSON. They are both men of experience in government. They are both liberal-minded gentlemen, and they will carry on this great Government of ours in the manner in which it ought to be carried on. And you must elect them in DATE. I am glad to see the great progress this area is making. I have been reading a copy of your good newspaper just as I came along here. I have been in politics for DATE, and in elective public office for DATE, and down in GPE there are CARDINAL metropolitan papers, and I never had one for me in my whole life. If they did get for me, I would know I was wrong. I wish we had newspapers like that in GPE. We need them. In most places I visit, the newspapers are against the NORP. But your paper is a good one, and I am happy to say that about your newspaper. Your paper told of the progress you are making--when most papers keep telling the people how bad things are. If you listen to most of them, you would think the country is just on the verge of ruin. There are more animals in the county DATE, as compared with last; there are more acres of bearing orchard and more acres of meadow hay; people own more household furniture; stocks of merchandise are greater; there is more farm equipment, except combines; there has been a great deal of building and improvements; and mining is on the increase. Well now, that is an awful situation for the NORP to have to swallow in DATE. In addition to this, I understand you have a fine new veterans hospital here that will be of great value to this whole area. I congratulate you on that record. You are especially fortunate here, but we are having the same sort of situation all over GPE. This prosperity of ours is driving the NORP politicians almost crazy. That is the reason for those CARDINAL little men following me. They cannot stand to see the country so well off under a NORP administration. I was reading a speech by the NORP candidate for President DATE. He was doing his best to prove that this prosperity did not exist--that it was all done with mirrors, according to him.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Rear Platform Remarks in Utah and Colorado

text: Do you want to stand still, mired in the mud of this New Deal prosperity, or do you want to march down the shining corridor of progress to the NORP idea of prosperity? Well, what do you think? I know what I think, and I know I am pouring it on them so you will not have to. Do you want to march off under the orders of the NORP general, down that shining corridor --whatever that is--or would you just as soon stay behind, stuck in the mud of this terrible New Deal prosperity ? The last time the NORP marched off with us we were a long time getting back where we belonged. DATE is DATE of your community chest drive, and I hope you will take a little of that prosperity and give it to help others who need it.
