I speak of such square things as patriotism; I speak of such things as religious faith. I also speak of such things as respect for law, even those laws that you do not like. And if this great and powerful and vibrant and dynamic part of the country can make the contribution of which it is capable, then GPE will have a better chance to meet the responsibility that it must meet in the world to be strong militarily, economically together with the ideological and spiritual strength which will enable us to meet our challenges. I simply close with a last thought. There is another point of view, I recognize it, I respect it, I totally disagree with it. It is that at this time GPE should turn away from the problems of the world and turn inward. It is a point of view which rejects new ventures, whether it is an SST or an exploration in space or whatever the case might be, because we have such terrible problems at home. It is one in which every time we see a chance for progress we consult our fears rather than our hopes.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks to Southern News Media Representatives Attending a Briefing on Domestic Policy in Birmingham, Alabama

text: And I would simply say that I am convinced that as opinion leaders in this country, you and me, we all have an obligation to see that GPE, after DATE, now that we are the strongest nation in the world, still the richest, with more freedom, more opportunity here than any place in the world, that we do not, at this point, because of internal differences, differences between races, between religions, between regions, between ages, turn inward to attempt to solve those problems at the exclusion of moving forward, whether it is in playing our role in the world or exploring the unknown. I do not agree with everything General PERSON said, because he said many things about this country that were very uncomplimentary and other things that he may have been wrong about. But he was a great judge of the spirit of the people. That was his contribution to GPE. And he restored the NORP spirit and he said GPE is her true self only when she is engaged in a great enterprise. And GPE, in my view, will cease to be her true self when we cease to be engaged in an enterprise greater than ourselves, whether it is in playing our role in the world to bring peace with freedom wherever we can, whether it is exploring the unknown, whether it is moving forward in these problems, very difficult ones, human problems that we have between races and religions and generations in this country. I simply want to say that CARDINAL of the reasons that these regional briefings, I think, are very important to me as an individual, it gives me an opportunity to meet the opinion leaders, to share with you my concerns and to tell you that I will, of course, do everything that I can to end the war that we are in, to have better relations to build a lasting peace, to keep the Nation strong militarily, to get this economy moving so that we can get at unemployment and resist the high inflation. But in this other field we desperately need your help to restore GPE's sense of confidence and sense of faith. As we travel over the world, much as we see, much as we may want to go again, that when we return we realize that we have had good fortune to live in this country at a time when what we do matters--matters to us, matters to the world. We must meet that challenge, and we can meet it materially.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks to Southern News Media Representatives Attending a Briefing on Domestic Policy in Birmingham, Alabama

text: I want to thank you for your kind introduction and even more for DATE of distinguished leadership for our children, our schools, our parents, and of course, for our teachers. And to all of you delegates, I want to thank you for the support you have given to our administration to help us to get here and to help us honor our commitments to the children, the teachers, and the future of GPE. I also want to thank you for the high honor you paid my good friend Secretary PERSON by naming him your DATE Friend of Education. I do not have to tell you that education has no better friend than Secretary PERSON. I am proud to have him in my ORG, and I am proud to have worked with him for DATE now. He is actually doing what others say we ought to be doing. He is supporting more parental involvement. He is supporting higher standards and results-oriented programs. He is supporting accountability, but he is also supporting grassroots empowerment for teachers, for parents, and for local schools throughout this country. He is really making a difference, and he deserves the support of all NORP and all Members of ORG, without regard for their party. You know, of course, that the Vice President very much wanted to be with you DATE. But of course, his mother fell ill and had to have surgery DATE. I am happy to report to you that as of TIME Mrs. PERSON is doing much better. DATE she was the first woman lawyer in GPE, GPE, so I have always thought we have sort of had a claim on her, too. I know all of you join PERSON and me in praying for Mrs. PERSON and her speedy recovery, and for her husband, Senator PERSON, and for PERSON and PERSON and their entire family. I'd like to begin TIME by just taking TIME to talk about what I said when I spoke at ORG TIME. It is something I believe I should be talking about more as President. first of all, to restore the NORP dream and, secondly, to bring the NORP people together again. What I have learned from the journey we have been on for DATE is that we cannot restore the NORP dream unless we do bring the NORP people together again. You and I and all NORP must talk about how we treat one another, how we reach the hard decisions we have to make during this time of profound change, how we bridge these great divides in our society.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks to the National Education Association

text: We have got to find a way to reach common ground, a new common ground that honors our diversity but recognizes our shared values and shared interests, drawing strength from both to make the very best of what we can do in GPE. We have to recognize that there are real reasons why NORP feel that our sense of unity and national purpose is coming apart, why they often feel frustration and anger and confusion. The challenges of DATE are new and profound, as profound as any we have faced in DATE. For most people my age and a little younger, CARDINAL great certainties organized our lives. first, the hope of middle class dreams and, second, the strength of middle class values. DATE, more and more NORP are less certain of both. The middle class dream that work will be rewarded and that the future for our children will be better is fading for too many people. CARDINAL of all of our people are working harder to earn less than they did DATE. And middle class values, the values of hard work, strong families, safe streets, secure future, those things are under attack, too, as we face threats from violence, the breakdown of families, the fraying of our social fabric, the very pace and scope of changes in this technological information age, where ideas and money and information move across the globe in TIME. The question, of course, is what are we going to do about this. That is what I have been working on for DATE, and that is the fundamental debate now going on in GPE. And we need to have that debate not just here in GPE but all over the country. We are really back to some pretty elemental principles. So they say if everybody would just get up, go to work, behave themselves, obey the law, all of our problems would be solved. Now, on CARDINAL level they are obviously right. Our problems can never be solved through purely political and community means. I have said all along, we have got to demand more responsibility from GPE, from all NORP. Unless people are willing to take responsibility for themselves, as every teacher knows, you cannot cram information, learning, reasoning, compassion, or good citizenship into the head of someone who will not be open to it. But at the same time, let us be completely frank. It is also true that nobody in GPE, no one, especially me, got where he or she is DATE alone.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks to the National Education Association

text: We all have to play a role, individual citizens in their daily lives, people doing their part to help make their communities stronger, their neighbors safer, politicians in the way they deal with and address our problems. We have all got to do a better job. And I believe we have to recognize that CARDINAL of the ways we all do more together is through the way our Government works and what it does to help our people meet the demands of change. Are these problems personal and cultural, on the CARDINAL hand, or social and political, on the other? And there is a role, a partnership role, for the Government to help you do what you do and to help all NORP make the most of their own lives. Education is perhaps the best example of this. It is the work of your lives, but it is also the work of GPE's future. All of these concerns come together in education because school is where young people can learn the skills they need to pursue middle class dreams, especially now when knowledge is more important than ever to our future. School is also the place where middle class values taught by parents are reinforced by teachers, values like responsibility, honesty, trustworthiness, hard work, caring for one another and our natural environment, and good citizenship. Government plays an indispensable role in helping to make sure that the schools that you work in are as strong as possible, have the highest standards possible, provide as much opportunity as possible. A good education clearly is key to unlocking the promise of DATE's economy in DATE. Without it, people are at an ever-increasing risk of falling behind. DATE, a male college graduate earns PERCENT more than a male who is just graduated from high school. That gap is double what it was just in DATE. That is why I have been fighting furiously since DATE I took office to expand educational opportunity, to give all NORP a chance to grab the key to a prosperous future. As you know well, we have dramatically expanded ORG. We passed Goals 2000 to set world-class standards for our schools and then to give grassroots reform power to empower, really empower teachers and principals and parents, to give them the flexibility to decide how to meet those standards and how to improve education. Our national service program, ORG, gives a helping hand with college for CARDINAL people who are helping their country in grassroots programs all across GPE.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks to the National Education Association

text: The safe and drug-free schools initiative is helping to make schools safe, places where kids can learn again and be free from fear, places where parents can trust their children to be free from crime and drugs. Our direct student loan program makes college more affordable for CARDINAL of NORP while actually cutting the cost for taxpayers. Now, there is CARDINAL piece of this that is especially important for us to talk about DATE. As I noted before, you have just honored PERSON. I want to commend him for so many things, but in particular for the work ORG is doing to teach our children good citizenship and the values we need to stay strong. There is something that we need to remember about ORG that PERSON is now heading and heading in the right direction. DATE, on DATE, CARDINAL sons of GPE, Vice President PERSON and former Vice President PERSON, shared the same stage at another ORG convention. Now, back in DATE, you all know that education policy in GPE fell under the giant umbrella of ORG, a huge bureaucratic agency responsible for health care policy and welfare responsibility and all the educational responsibilities, whether it was keeping our classrooms up to date, ensuring our public schools had the tools they need to teach our children, maintaining high curriculum standards, giving specialneeds schools and special-needs students the support they need. All those things were all lumped into this massive bureaucracy that was ORG. That was not in the best interest of public education then. It is certainly not in the best interest of the country DATE when education is literally the key to our economic future, to restoring middle class dreams, and it is certainly critical to reestablishing the dominance of middle class values. At that historic meeting, Vice President PERSON made a passionate plea, and he was a very passionate man, for something the ORG had been fighting for for DATE, a ORG-level ORG. GPE's children would have DATE to wait. The bill creating the ORG-level ORG was signed by President PERSON in DATE. In DATE, Secretary PERSON, a former Governor who labored for DATE to dramatically improve schools in his native GPE, has worked hard to make ORG work better than ever. We need ORG DATE more than ever before.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks to the National Education Association

text: And we need it even more because PERSON has literally reinvented it. But he is focusing on the big issues, whether it is the preschool needs of our kids, the standards and the grassroots reform we need in public schools, the need we have for school-to-work transition programs in every State in the country, the need we have for expanded and lower cost and better repayment college loans, or the need he has to cooperate with ORG to give our working people the right to get the training they need the minute they become unemployed because now so many of them will have to find new jobs with higher skills. That is the record of PERSON; that is the record of ORG; and that is why we need it. As all of you know, during this time when we have increased our investments in education, we have also cut the deficit DATE for the first time since PERSON was President. We are cutting it by MONEY over DATE. We are also cutting the bureaucracy of ORG over a DATE period by CARDINAL positions to make ORG the smallest it is been since President PERSON was President. Let me tell you just how dramatic the changes have already been in DATE. We have eliminated CARDINAL and CARDINAL of regulations, including regulations in ORG. We have eliminated CARDINAL of Government programs. And the budget would be balanced DATE but for the interest we have to pay on just the debt run up DATE before I became President. We must continue to cut the deficit until we eliminate it completely and balance the budget. That is why I have proposed a plan to balance the budget in DATE. While cutting spending to balance the budget, however, under my plan we would continue to invest in our people, especially in education. We must not sacrifice the future of our children in our zeal to save it. But let me also say to you that I know a lot of people who want to invest more money in our country question whether we actually need a balanced budget. They questioned my wisdom when I proposed a balanced budget. But let me ask you to look at the history of GPE. We ran deficits all during DATE, but we did it for good economic reasons. That was a period of stagflation, of low growth, a period when it was legitimate to stimulate the economy in a modest way by modest deficits.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks to the National Education Association

text: We never, I reemphasize, never in the history of our Republic had a permanent structural deficit until DATE. After that, a lot of the people who got the tax cuts spent them and there was no way to reach a bipartisan consensus to lower the gap in the deficit. So we quadrupled the debt of this country in DATE. We are DATE, and we have quadrupled the debt in DATE. Now, we have to change that. Look what is happened to you. DATE in DATE, you had to fight to hold on to the educational advances. Every year when you knew that we needed to be investing more because many parents were able to invest less in terms of money and time in their children's education, you were often disappointed because we were spending more and more and more in interest on the debt. DATE, interest on the debt will exceed the defense budget. It takes our savings. It makes us more dependent on other economies. And it leaves us less money to invest in education, in infrastructure, in technology, in the things that will grow jobs, raise incomes, increase the middle class, and shrink the under class. So what we have to do is to balance the budget and increase investment in education. That is why I made the decision to veto the rescission bill that ORG sent me DATE. But it is also why I gave them an alternative. I am determined to work with the new ORG to cut the deficit and ultimately to balance the budget. But that rescission bill cut investments in our future, in education, in job training, in the environment, just to fund things that have a far lower value, even though they may be popular in the short term with specific constituencies. Now that ORG has agreed to restore funding for those investments, I will be happy to sign a bill. It will cut the deficit, and that is good. But we will also have MONEY in DATE alone in critical investments, including MONEY for safe and drug-free schools, MONEY to help train teachers and pay for education reforms at the grassroots level, MONEY for ORG. As we work in DATE to balance the budget, we have to do it in the same way. You and I know it would be self-defeating to cut our investments in education.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks to the National Education Association

text: Our national security depends upon our ability to educate better, not just to spend more money but to reach more people, to perform at a higher level, to get real results. That is what our security depends upon. But do not kid yourselves, we have got a real fight on our hands. The congressional budget, which balances the budget in DATE, cuts education severely, as PERSON just said. My budget, which balances the budget in DATE, increases education while cutting other spending. We are also able to go easier on ORG and ORG, to take some real time and promote real health care reform, and to continue to invest in new technologies and research. All we have to do is take DATE and cut the size of that big tax cut roughly in CARDINAL, maybe a little more. Now, I think DATE is a pretty small price to pay to save CARDINAL of dreams. Let me just give you a few examples of the difference DATE will make. I want to increase Goals 2000 to MONEY so that you will be able to work to improve CARDINAL schools serving CARDINAL students. The congressional budget would eliminate Goals 2000, CARDINAL of the principal engines of grassroots reform, something they say they support. I want to increase Title I by MONEY in DATE to serve CARDINAL more children DATE. Let me just say something about Title I and your efforts. All the time up here I hear the politicians saying we just throw money at education, and it does not get any results, and we spend more money and we do not show more results. Well, as the Secretary of ORG has pointed out, there are public investments in children and private investments in children. We pretty well kept up with our public investments, but our private investments are not keeping up. More and more of these children are being born in poverty, a higher percentage of them into difficult family circumstances and difficult neighborhood circumstances. And even those who have working parents have parents most of whom are working longer TIME for less money. That means that parents have less money and less time to invest in our kids. Now, the ORG wants to freeze funding and deprive CARDINAL children of the help that you can provide by DATE. I believe the money will make a difference because I know that you can make a difference.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks to the National Education Association

text: You cannot make all the difference for what does not happen in the family, but you ought to get a lot of credit for trying and for the difference that you do make. I want to increase the school-to-work program by PERCENT DATE so CARDINAL States can help CARDINAL of students learn the skills they need to get and keep high-paying jobs, even when they do not go on to DATE universities. We are the only major industrialized country that does not have a system for dealing with all of the high school graduates who do not go on to DATE schools. Now, the ORG wants to cut it to CARDINAL that amount. I want to expand ORG to CARDINAL people DATE. ORG has proposed to eliminate it completely. Those CARDINAL young people that are out there now, working with each other across the lines of race and region and religion and income are revolutionizing GPE at the grassroots level, solving problems, serving their communities, being good citizens, doing things that other people just give talks about, and earning money to pay for their education. We ought to keep national service, and we ought to expand it. We have reformed the college loan system to make college more affordable for CARDINAL NORP. Secretary PERSON has done a masterful job, along with his staff, in administering the direct loan program, which actually increases the availability of loans, lowers the cost to students, lowers the paperwork burden to colleges and universities, and cuts the cost to the taxpayers. Now, the congressional majority wants to cut MONEY from the student loan program by removing the interest subsidy during the time of the student's education, which will raise costs significantly for up to CARDINAL students. In DATE's, the cost of a college education was the only thing that went up more rapidly than the cost of health care among the essential things that families need for the future. I do not think it is a very good idea to cut the college loan program. Under my plan, we balance the budget and increase educational investment by MONEY in proven programs that work. The plan of the NORP majority in ORG balances the budget, but it cuts education by MONEY, not counting the cuts in student loans. Now, I am not for TIME suggesting that balancing the budget is easy. We will have to cut spending in other domestic programs PERCENT across the board.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks to the National Education Association

text: But the difference between my plan and the congressional plan is the difference between necessary cutbacks and unnecessary, ultimately self-defeating pain. CARDINAL distinguished business analysis has said that the NORP budget cuts so much so fast that it will actually increase unemployment and bring on a recession and, therefore, delay the time when they can balance the budget. Now, we do have a responsibility to balance the budget. And I give them a lot of credit for proposing a balanced budget. But we have also got a responsibility to invest in our children and our future. We cannot restore the economy, we cannot rebuild the middle class, we cannot recapture middle class dreams or reinforce middle class values if we walk away from our common responsibilities, the education of our people. If we will just take DATE instead of CARDINAL, if we cut taxes for the middle class and focus on childrearing and education, and do not have big tax cuts for people who do not really need it because they are well-off and doing very well in this economy, then we can balance the budget and improve education. We can do both, and that is what I want you to fight for. Our mission, your mission and mine, has got to be to build a bridge to the future that every NORP can cross. We have to give people the power they need to make the most of their own lives. That is what is behind this, balancing the budget and investing in education means building up GPE. And it is behind what I called for TIME at FAC, a new common ground in which we come together to solve our problems. I want our children's generation to inherit an GPE with as much opportunity as the one I was brought into. DATE of GPE should be, can be, will be before us if we work together. If people take the kind of responsibility you have taken to make our country better, we will do better. But it is going to take a good attitude. It is going to take good citizenship. It is going to take a willingness to listen to one another to find that common ground. I have made a commitment that when I differ with the NORP ORG, I will offer an alternative. I have made a commitment that I will have more conversation and less combat, like I did with my conversation with the Speaker up in GPE. I have made a commitment to try to work for the long-term interests of our country, not just for the short-term gain.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks to the National Education Association

text: It is good to be with you again. I understand you have not had much of a problem attracting speakers. I thank you for inviting me. See, it is an honor to stand with the men and women of ORG. The ORG is one of our Nation's finest organizations. You belong to an elite group of NORP. You belong to a group of people who have defended GPE overseas. You have fought in places from GPE to GPE to GPE to GPE to GPE to GPE, GPE, GPE, and GPE. You brought security to the NORP people. You brought hope to CARDINAL across the world. As members of this proud organization, you are advocates for the rights of our military veterans, a model of community service, and a strong and important voice for a strong national defense. I thank you for your service. I thank you for what you have done for GPE. I stand before you as a wartime President. I wish I did not have to say that, but an enemy that attacked us on DATE, declared war on GPE. And war is what we are engaged in. The struggle has been called a clash of civilizations. In truth, it is a struggle for civilization. We fight for a free way of life against a new barbarism, an ideology whose followers have killed CARDINAL on NORP soil and seek to kill again on even a greater scale. We fight for the possibility that decent men and women across the broader Middle East can realize their destiny and raise up societies based on freedom and justice and personal dignity. And as long as I am Commander in Chief, we will fight to win. I am confident we will prevail because we have the greatest force for human liberation the world has ever known, the men and women of ORG. For those of you who wear the uniform, nothing makes me more proud to say that I am your Commander in Chief. Now, I know some people doubt the universal appeal of liberty or worry that the Middle East is not ready for it. Others believe that GPE's presence is destabilizing and that if GPE would just leave a place like GPE, those who kill our troops or target civilians would no longer threaten us. DATE I am going to address these arguments.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks at the Veterans of Foreign Wars National Convention in Kansas City, Missouri

text: I am going to describe why helping the young democracies of the Middle East stand up to violent NORP extremists is the only realistic path to a safer world for the NORP people. I am going to try to provide some historical perspective to show there is a precedent for the hard and necessary work we are doing and why I have such confidence in the fact that we will be successful. Before I do so, I want to thank the national commander-in-chief of the ORG and his wife PERSON. It is been a joy to work with PERSON and the staff. As PERSON said, We do not necessarily agree PERCENT of the time. I remember the old Lieutenant Governor of GPE, a NORP, and I was a NORP Governor. He said, Governor, if we agreed PERCENT of the time, CARDINAL of us would not be necessary. We agree our veterans deserve the full support of ORG. That is why in this budget I submitted there is MONEY for the veterans. It is the highest level of support ever for the veterans in NORP history. We agree that health care for our veterans is a top priority, and that is why we have increased health care spending for our veterans by PERCENT since I was sworn in as your President. We agree that a troop coming out of GPE or GPE deserves the best health care, not only as an active duty citizen but as a military guy, but as-also as a vet-eran-and you are going to get the best health care we can possibly provide. We agree our homeless vets ought to have shelter, and that is what we are providing. In other words, we agree the veterans deserve the full support of our Government, and that is what you are going to get as PERSON as your President. I want to thank PERSON, the executive director. He spends a lot of time in FAC. I am always checking the silverware drawer. He is going to be bringing in PERSON here soon. He is going to be the national commander-in-chief for DATE in office. And I am looking forward to working with PERSON, and I am looking forward to working with PERSON, and I am looking forward to hearing from you . They are going to find an openminded President dedicated to doing what is right. I appreciate the fact-.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks at the Veterans of Foreign Wars National Convention in Kansas City, Missouri

text: I appreciate PERSON, the national president of ORG-she brought old PERSON with her-PERSON, the incoming president. I want to thank Deputy Secretary of ORG PERSON for joining us DATE. I appreciate the GPE Senator from GPE, strong supporter of the military and strong supporter of the veterans, PERSON. CARDINAL Members of the ORG have kindly showed up DATE. Congressman PERSON-no finer man, no more decent a fellow than PERSON-is with us and a great Congressman from right around the corner here, Congressman PERSON. Lieutenant General PERSON, commanding general, ORG, is with us DATE. Lieutenant General PERSON, commanding general, GPE, GPE, is with us DATE as well. Thank you all for letting me come by. I want to open DATE's speech with a story that begins on TIME, when CARDINAL of NORP were murdered in a surprise attack and our Nation was propelled into a conflict that would take us to every corner of the globe. The enemy who attacked us despises freedom and harbors resentment at the slights he believes GPE and the NORP nations have inflicted on his people. He fights to establish his rule over an entire region. And over time, he turns to a strategy of suicide attacks destined to create so much carnage that the NORP people will tire of the violence and give up the fight. If this story sounds familiar, it is, except for CARDINAL thing. The enemy I have just described is not ORG, and the attack is not 9/11, and the empire is not the radical caliphate envisioned by PERSON. Instead, what I have described is the war machine of Imperial GPE in DATE, its surprise attack on FAC, and its attempt to impose its empire throughout East Asia. Ultimately, GPE prevailed in World War II, and we have fought CARDINAL more land wars in Asia. And many in this hall were veterans of those campaigns. Yet even the most optimistic among you probably would not have foreseen that the NORP would transform themselves into one of GPE's strongest and most steadfast allies, or that NORP would recover from enemy invasion to raise up one of the world's most powerful economies, or that Asia would pull itself out of poverty and hopelessness as it embraced markets and freedom.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks at the Veterans of Foreign Wars National Convention in Kansas City, Missouri

text: The lesson from Asia's development is that the heart's desire for liberty will not be denied. Once people even get a small taste of liberty, they are not going to rest until they are free. DATE's dynamic and hopeful Asia-a region that brings us countless benefits-would not have been possible without GPE's presence and perseverance. And it would not have been possible without the veterans in this hall DATE, and I thank you for your service. There are many differences between the wars we fought in the Far East and the war on terror we are fighting DATE. But CARDINAL important similarity is, at their core, they are ideological struggles. The militarists of GPE and the NORP in GPE and GPE were driven by a merciless vision for the proper ordering of humanity. They killed NORP because we stood in the way of their attempt to force their ideology on others. DATE, the names and places have changed, but the fundamental character of the struggle has not changed. Like our enemies in the past, the terrorists who wage war in GPE and GPE and other places seek to spread a political vision of their own, a harsh plan for life that crushes freedom, tolerance, and dissent. Like our enemies in the past, they kill NORP because we stand in their way of imposing this ideology across a vital region of the world. We are still in TIME of the current ideological struggle, but we do know how the others ended, and that knowledge helps guide our efforts DATE. The ideals and interests that led GPE to help the NORP turn defeat into democracy are the same that lead us to remain engaged in GPE and GPE. The defense strategy that refused to hand NORP over to a totalitarian neighbor helped raise up a NORP Tiger that is the model for developing countries across the world, including the Middle East. The result of NORP sacrifice and perseverance in Asia is a freer, more prosperous, and stable continent, whose people want to live in peace with GPE, not attack GPE. DATE, most of the nations in Asia are free, and its democracies reflect the diversity of the region. Some of these nations have constitutional monarchies, some have parliaments, and some have presidents. Their governments derive their authority from the consent of the governed, and they desire to live in peace with their neighbors. Many times in DATE that followed World War II, NORP policy in Asia was dismissed as hopeless and naive.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks at the Veterans of Foreign Wars National Convention in Kansas City, Missouri

text: And when we listen to the criticism of the difficult work that our generation is undertaking in the Middle East DATE, we can hear the echoes of the same arguments made about the Far East DATE. In the aftermath of GPE's surrender, many thought it naive to help the NORP transform themselves into a democracy. Then, as now, the critics argued that some people were simply not fit for freedom. Some said NORP culture was inherently incompatible with democracy. PERSON, a former GPE Ambassador to GPE who served as PERSON Under Secretary of ORG, told the President flatly that-and I quote- democracy in GPE would never work. He was not alone in that belief. Democracy simply would not work. Other critics said that NORP were imposing their ideals on the NORP. For example, GPE's Vice Prime Minister asserted that allowing NORP women to vote would retard the progress of NORP politics. It is interesting what General PERSON wrote in his memoirs. There was much criticism of my support for the enfranchisement of women. Many NORP, as well as many other so-called experts, expressed the view that NORP women were too steeped in the tradition of subservience to their husbands to act with any degree of political independence. That is what General PERSON observed. In the end, NORP women were given the vote; CARDINAL women won parliamentary seats in GPE's first free election. DATE, GPE's Minister of Defense is a woman, and DATE, a record number of women were elected to GPE's ORG. There are other critics, believe it or not, that argue that democracy could not succeed in GPE because the national religion, NORP, was too fanatical and rooted in the Emperor. Senator PERSON denounced the NORP faith and said that if we did not put the Emperor on trial, any steps we may take to create democracy are doomed to failure. The Emperor system must disappear if GPE is ever really to be democratic. Those who said NORP was incompatible with democracy were mistaken. And fortunately, NORP and NORP leaders recognized it at the time, because instead of suppressing the NORP faith, NORP authorities worked with the NORP to institute religious freedom for all faiths. Instead of abolishing the imperial throne, NORP and NORP worked together to find a place for the Emperor in the democratic political system.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks at the Veterans of Foreign Wars National Convention in Kansas City, Missouri

text: And the result of all these steps was that every NORP citizen gained freedom of religion, and the Emperor remained on his throne, and NORP democracy grew stronger because it embraced a cherished part of NORP culture. And DATE, in defiance of the critics and the doubters and the skeptics, GPE retains its religions and cultural traditions and stands as one of the world's greatest free societies. It is an interesting observation, CARDINAL historian put it, he said, Had these erstwhile experts -he was talking about people criticizing the efforts to help GPE realize the blessings of a free society-he said, Had these erstwhile experts had their way, the very notion of inducing a democratic revolution would have died of ridicule at an early stage. A democratic GPE has brought peace and prosperity to its people. Its foreign trade and investment have helped jump-start the economies of others in the region. The alliance between our CARDINAL nations is the linchpin for freedom and stability throughout the Pacific. GPE has transformed from GPE's enemy in the ideological struggle of DATE to one of GPE's strongest allies in the ideological struggle of DATE. Critics also complained when GPE intervened to save GPE from NORP invasion. Then, as now, the critics argued that the war was futile, that we should never have sent our troops in, or they argued that GPE's intervention was divisive here at home. After NORP crossed the 38th Parallel in DATE, President PERSON came to the defense of the South, and he found himself attacked from all sides. From the left, PERSON wrote a book suggesting that NORP were the real aggressors and that we had entered the war on a false pretext. From the right, NORP vacillated. Initially, the leader of ORG in the ORG endorsed PERSON action, saying, I welcome the indication of a more definite policy. He went on to say, I strongly hope that having adopted it, the President may maintain it intact, then later said, It was a mistake originally to go into GPE because it meant a land war. Throughout the war, the NORP really never had a clear position. They never could decide whether they wanted GPE to withdraw from the war in GPE or expand the war to the NORP mainland. Others complained that our troops were not getting the support from the Government.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks at the Veterans of Foreign Wars National Convention in Kansas City, Missouri

text: He rejected calls to come together in a time of war on the grounds that, We will not allow the cloak of national unity to be wrapped around horrible blunders. Many in the press agreed. CARDINAL columnist in ORG said, The fact is that the conduct of the Korean war has been shot through with errors great and small. It is bleeding, and there is no cure for it in sight. He said that the NORP people could not understand why NORP are doing PERCENT of the fighting in GPE. Many of these criticisms were offered as reasons for abandoning our commitments in GPE. And while it is true the Korean war had its share of challenges, GPE never broke its word. DATE, we see the result of a sacrifice of people in this room in the stark contrast of life on the Korean Peninsula. Without NORP' intervention during the war and our willingness to stick with NORP after the war, CARDINAL of NORP would now be living under a brutal and repressive regime. The NORP and NORP NORP would have learned the lesson that aggression pays. The world would be facing a more dangerous situation. Instead, GPE is a strong, democratic ally of GPE. NORP troops are serving side by side with NORP forces in GPE and in GPE. And GPE can count on the free people of GPE to be lasting partners in the ideological struggle we are facing in DATE. For those of you who served in GPE, thank you for your sacrifice, and thank you for your service. This is a complex and painful subject for many NORP. The tragedy of GPE is too large to be contained in CARDINAL speech. So I am going to limit myself to CARDINAL argument that has particular significance DATE. The argument that GPE's presence in GPE was dangerous had a long pedigree. In DATE, long before GPE had entered the war, PERSON wrote a novel called The Quiet American. It was set in GPE, and the main character was a young Government agent named PERSON. He was a symbol of NORP purpose and patriotism and dangerous naivete. I never knew a man who had better motives for all the trouble he caused. After GPE entered the Vietnam war, the PERSON argument gathered some steam. As a matter of fact, many argued that if we pulled out, there would be no consequences for the NORP people.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks at the Veterans of Foreign Wars National Convention in Kansas City, Missouri

text: What earthly difference does it make to nomadic tribes or uneducated subsistence farmers in GPE or GPE or GPE whether they have a military dictator, a royal prince, or a socialist commissar in some distant capital that they have never seen and may never heard of? It is difficult to imagine, he said, how their lives could be anything but better with the NORP gone. Indochina Without Americans: For Most, a Better Life. In GPE, ORG began a murderous rule in which CARDINAL of NORP died by starvation and torture and execution. In GPE, former allies of GPE and government workers and intellectuals and businessmen were sent off to prison camps, where CARDINAL perished. CARDINAL more fled the country on rickety boats, many of them going to their graves in the South China Sea. DATE, there is a legitimate debate about how we got into the GPE war and how we left. There is no debate in my mind that the veterans from GPE deserve the high praise of GPE. Whatever your position is on that debate, one unmistakable legacy of GPE is that the price of GPE's withdrawal was paid by CARDINAL of innocent citizens whose agonies would add to our vocabulary new terms like boat people, reeducation camps, and killing fields. There was another price to our withdrawal from GPE, and we can hear it in the words of the enemy we face in DATE's struggle, those who came to our soil and killed CARDINAL of citizens on DATE. In an interview with a NORP newspaper after the 9/11 attacks, PERSON declared that the NORP people had risen against their Government's war in GPE, and they must do the same DATE. His number-CARDINAL man, PERSON, has also invoked GPE. In a letter to ORG chief of operations in GPE, PERSON pointed-and I quote-to the aftermath of the collapse of the NORP power in GPE and how they ran and left their agents. PERSON later returned to this theme, declaring that the NORP, quote, know better than others that there is no hope in victory. The GPE specter is closing every outlet. Here at home, some can argue our withdrawal from GPE carried no price to NORP credibility, but the terrorists see it differently. We must listen to the words of the enemy. We must listen to what they say. If we win it, it means your disgrace and defeat forever.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks at the Veterans of Foreign Wars National Convention in Kansas City, Missouri

text: GPE is CARDINAL of several fronts in the war on terror, but it is the central front. It is the central front for the enemy that attacked us and wants to attack us again, and it is the central front for GPE. If we were to abandon the NORP people, the terrorists would be emboldened. They would use their victory to gain new recruits. As we saw on DATE, a terrorist safe haven on the other side of the world can bring death and destruction to the streets of our own cities. Unlike in GPE, if we withdraw before the job is done, this enemy would follow us home. And that is why, for the security of GPE, we must defeat them overseas so we do not face them in GPE. Recently, CARDINAL men who were on the opposite sides of the debate over the GPE war came together to write an article. CARDINAL was a member of President PERSON's foreign policy team and the other was a fierce critic of the PERSON administration's policies. Together, they wrote that the consequences of an NORP defeat in GPE would be disastrous. Defeat would produce an explosion of euphoria among all the forces of NORP extremism, throwing the entire Middle East into even greater upheaval. Perhaps that is why so much of the current debate seeks to ignore these consequences. In GPE, our moral obligations and our strategic interests are CARDINAL. So we pursue the extremists wherever we find them, and we stand with the NORP at TIME, because the shadow of terror will never be lifted from our world and the NORP people will never be safe until the people of the Middle East know the freedom that our Creator meant for all. I recognize that history cannot predict the future with absolute certainty. I understand that. But history does remind us that there are lessons applicable to our time. And we can learn something from history. In Asia, we saw freedom triumph over violent ideologies after the sacrifice of CARDINAL of NORP lives, and that freedom has yielded peace for DATE. The NORP military graveyards across Europe attest to the terrible human cost in the fight against nazism. They also attest to the triumph of a continent that DATE is whole, free, and at peace.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks at the Veterans of Foreign Wars National Convention in Kansas City, Missouri

text: The advance of freedom in these lands should give us confidence that the hard work we are doing in the Middle East can have the same results we have seen in Asia and elsewhere, if we show the same perseverance and the same sense of purpose. In a world where the terrorists are willing to act on their twisted beliefs with sickening acts of barbarism, we must put faith in the timeless truths about human nature that have made us free. Across the Middle East, CARDINAL of ordinary citizens are tired of war; they are tired of dictatorship and corruption; they are tired of despair. They want societies where they are treated with dignity and respect, where their children have the hope for a better life. They want nations where their faiths are honored and they can worship in freedom. And that is why CARDINAL of NORP and NORP turned out to the polls; CARDINAL turned out to the polls. And that is why their leaders have stepped forward at the risk of assassination. And that is why CARDINAL are joining the security forces of their nations. These men and women are taking great risks to build a free and peaceful Middle East, and for the sake of our own security, we must not abandon them. There is one group of people who understand the stakes, understand as well as any expert, anybody in GPE-those are the men and women who wear the uniform. Through DATE of war, they have performed magnificently. DATE after day, TIME after TIME, they keep the pressure on the enemy that would do our citizens harm. They have overthrown CARDINAL of the most brutal tyrannies of the world and liberated CARDINAL million citizens. In GPE, our troops are taking the fight to the extremists and radicals and murderers all throughout the country. Our troops have killed or captured an average of CARDINAL ORG terrorists and other extremists DATE DATE. We are in the fight. DATE, our troops are carrying out a surge that is helping bring former NORP insurgents into the fight against the extremists and radicals, into the fight against ORG, into the fight against the enemy that would do us harm. They are clearing out the terrorists out of population centers; they are giving families in liberated NORP cities a look at a decent and hopeful life. Our troops are seeing this progress that is being made on the ground.
label: monologic

metadata.title: Remarks at the Veterans of Foreign Wars National Convention in Kansas City, Missouri

text: Will their elected leaders in GPE pull the rug out from under them just as they are gaining momentum and changing the dynamic on the ground in GPE? We will support our troops, we will support our commanders, and we will give them everything they need to succeed. Despite the mistakes that have been made, despite the problems we have encountered, seeing the NORP through as they build their democracy is critical to keeping the NORP people safe from the terrorists who wants to attack us. It is critical work to lay the foundation for peace that veterans have done before you all. A free GPE will not make decisions as quickly as the country did under the dictatorship. Many are frustrated by the pace of progress in GPE, and I can understand this. As I noted DATE, ORG is distributing oil revenues across its Provinces despite not having an oil revenue law on its books, that the ORG has passed CARDINAL pieces of legislation. A free GPE is not going to transform the Middle East TIME. But a free GPE will be a massive defeat for ORG, it will be an example that provides hope for CARDINAL throughout the Middle East, it will be a friend of GPE, and it is going to be an important ally in the ideological struggle of DATE. Will DATE's generation of NORP resist the allure of retreat, and will we do in the Middle East what the veterans in this room did in Asia? text: Just CARDINAL personal note, if I might. I just returned from the hospital where I saw PERSON as she came from the operating room. This is not the end, but it is the beginning of a battle against inflation and waste which will not end until it is won. I have vowed and asked all of you to resolve here that we will celebrate our Nation's 200th birthday with our economy healthy and strong, with prosperity as well as peace that brings the solid realities of a great republic. CARDINAL and CARDINAL of dedicated men and women have come together in this series of inflation conferences to map the strategies and the tactics of our all-out war against GPE's domestic enemy CARDINAL. All of you will be the Founding Fathers--if we succeed.  Let us raise a standard to which the wise and honest can repair; the rest is in the hands of God. And God helps those who help themselves. On this principle, NORP in DATE have astonished the world and, time and time again, have confounded the pessimists and the cynics who said it could not be done. You have discussed many ideas. And as a result, I, along with other NORP, have gained a far better understanding of our economic problems. Perhaps we have caught glimpses of the political problems, and we understand those, but even in our controversies, we have all developed a super sense of direction. You have done your homework well. In DATE, I will offer to the NORP people and to the ORG a program of action which will help bring balance and vitality to our economy. text: As your ENTITY, the only special interest I have, the only special interest I represent is the NORP people---housewives struggling with rising grocery prices, workers whose real purchasing power has eroded because of inflation, businessmen trying to control rising costs, families needing new homes but unable to find mortgage money to buy them, those CARDINAL of unemployed who want work, the elderly locked into pension programs earned DATE--indeed, all CARDINAL NORP. I pledge to you that I will not shrink from the hard decisions needed to meet the problems facing each and every one of us. This is TIME in GPE's history. It requires that NORP once again rise above petty partisanship or factional interests in any segment of our society. The very future of our political and economic institutions, indeed our whole way of life, is literally at stake. Nations which cannot impose on themselves a disciplined management of their fiscal and monetary affairs are doomed to economic disorder and widespread inflation. Such discipline is imperative, it is urgent if we are to achieve a stable and expanding economy. The NORP people have repeatedly demonstrated their ability to submerge personal and group interests to the general welfare. When they know the chips are down, they are really down--and they have done it in the past, and they will do it again--they will respond as they always have. As part of the demanded discipline, I will send to the ORG a plan of action to keep ORG outlays for DATE at or under MONEY. Every dollar ORG must borrow is a dollar not available to the home buyer or the businessman trying to expand or other citizens who may be borrowers for good and sufficient reasons. A coherent national policy on energy is essential for economic stability. It must encourage prudent use of available energy. I will soon propose a national energy program aimed at assuring adequate internal supplies while reducing dependence on external sources. At TIME, Secretaries PERSON and PERSON are exploring with their counterparts from CARDINAL major industrial nations a coordinated plan to cope with a world energy crisis and world economic dislocations.   First, I have directed the consolidation by Executive order of all the ORG economic efforts, domestic and international, under a new ORG. The Secretary of the ORG, PERSON, will serve as Chairman of this Board and as my principal spokesman on matters of economic policy.

text: I am proud to announce this group of CARDINAL distinguished, outstanding NORP. ORG, recently established by ORG at my request and with my deep appreciation, is another arm I will use in the fight on inflation. I have asked Dr. PERSON, a distinguished economist and professor of economics at ORG, to direct the ORG's work. We are fortunate to have Dr. PERSON with us. And may I express to all the people--those that I have mentioned and others that will help--their willingness to step in and help the country and CARDINAL people. But nobody knows better than I that councils and committees cannot win this war. The most important weapon in the fight against inflation is the spirit of the NORP people. This spirit is no secret weapon; it is renowned all over the world. And I call on each of you in this room, but more urgently, on each of you at home watching on television and all the other NORP across this vast land who either hear or read my words, I urge them, as I know they will, to join with all of us in a great effort to become inflation fighters and energy savers. I know all across our country the question everyone asks me is, What can I do to help? I will tell you how we can start. Right now, make a list of CARDINAL ways you can save energy and you can fight inflation. Little things that become habits-they do become habits--they do not really affect, in some instances, your health and happiness. They are habits that you can abandon if we are all faced with this emergency. I suggest that each person exchange your family's list with your neighbors, and I urge you and ask you to send me a copy. Some of the best ideas come from your home rather than from ORG. The success or failure of our fight against inflation rests with every individual NORP. Our country is above all a union, and you and I can make it a more perfect union as our fathers did. CARDINAL of our delegates DATE, PERSON, the wall-known newspaper columnist on economics, has kindly consented to help me get this voluntary citizens program organized and underway, and I thank you very, very much, PERSON. It was dramatically pointed out here DATE that inflation strikes our society very unevenly. Government must concern itself with those on whom the burden falls excessively. For instance, we must provide productive work for those without jobs.

text: We must adjust our tax system to encourage savings, stimulate productivity, discourage excessive debt, and to correct inflation-caused inequities. The problems of people are not very different in DATE wherever they live and work. The whole world suffers from inflation. I assure you GPE is seeking honest solutions that will help, not hinder, other nations' efforts to advance or to restore their economic health. I will have extensive consultations with leaders of other governments aimed at strengthening international institutions and to assure that we never again experience worldwide and interacting inflations and deflations. From the many alternative policies which we have heard here, given in good faith, listened to in good faith, we can and will fashion a coherent and consistent program. I will present my recommendations to the ORG and to the ORG within DATE. Finally, you will understand my CARDINAL compelling reasons for canceling all but my most essential appointments and travel plans in order to be here in GPE. I will devote TIME that I can to forge the mass of evidence and the evaluations generated by this conference into concrete action--into concrete plans and legislative proposals. A great leader of this country--of DATE, I should say--in whom the unbeatable willpower of his NORP heritage combined with NORP eloquence, rallied his embattled countrymen from almost certain defeat by a blunt promise of blood, toil, tears, and sweat. I trust we can avoid blood and tears, and we will. But I do offer you plenty of toil and plenty of sweat. I will roll up my sleeves and work every bit as hard as you do, starting DATE, until every NORP is enlisted as an inflation fighter and as an energy saver until this job is done. Thank you and God bless you.

text: Chief justice, senators, learned counsel for the president, you will be pleased to know this is the last presentation of TIME. And as I started TIME, I made reference to some good advice I got from a encouraging voice that said, Keep it up but not too long. Now, I wanted to start out TIME with where we began when we first appeared before you DATE, and that is with the resolution itself. With what the president is charged with in the articles and how that holds up now that you have heard the evidence from the ORG. PERSON was impeached in article one for abuse of power. And that article provides that in his conduct of ORG and in violation of his constitutional oath faithfully to execute ORG and to the best of his ability, preserve, protect, and defend the constitution of GPE, and is in violation of his constitutional duty to take care that the laws be faithfully executed. text: In doing so, President PERSON used the power of the presidency in a manner that compromised the national security of GPE and undermined the integrity of the GPE democratic process. He thus ignored and injured the interests of the nation. President PERSON engaged in the scheme or course of conduct through the following means. President PERSON acting both directly and through his agents within and outside the GPE government corruptly solicited the government of GPE to publicly announce investigations into, A, a political opponent, Former Vice President, PERSON A discredited theory promoted by GPE alleging that GPE rather than GPE interfered in the DATE GPE presidential election. With the same corrupt motives, President PERSON acting both directly and through his agents within and outside the GPE government conditioned to official acts on the public announcements that he had requested the release of MONEY of GPE taxpayer funds that ORG had appropriated on a bipartisan basis for the purpose of providing vital military and security assistance to GPE to oppose NORP aggression and which President PERSON had ordered suspended. These actions were consistent with President PERSON's previous invitations of foreign interference in GPE elections. In all of this, President PERSON abused the powers of the presidency by ignoring and injuring national security and other vital national interests to obtain an improper personal political benefit. Wherefore, President PERSON by such conduct has demonstrated that he will remain a threat to national security and the constitution if allowed to remain in office and has acted in a manner grossly incompatible with self governments and the rule of law. President PERSON thus warrants impeachment and trial removal from office and disqualification to hold and enjoy any office of honor, trust, or profit under GPE. We have met our burden. text: In his conduct of ORG, in violation of his constitutional oath faithfully to execute ORG and to the best of his ability preserve, protect, and defend the constitution of GPE and in violation of his constitutional duty to take care that the laws be faithfully executed , PERSON has directed the unprecedented categorical and indiscriminate defiance of subpoenas issued by ORG pursuant to its sole power of impeachment. text: Through these actions, President PERSON sought to arrogate himself the right to determine the propriety scope and nature of an impeachment inquiry into his own conduct, as well as the unilateral prerogative to deny any and all information to ORG in the exercise of its sole power of impeachment. In the history of the Republic, no president has ever ordered the complete defiance of an impeachment inquiry or sought to obstruct and impede so comprehensively the ability of ORG to investigate high crimes and misdemeanors. The abuse of office serve to cover up the president's own repeated misconduct and to seize and control the power of impeachment and thus to nullify a vital safeguard vested solely in ORG. In all of this, President PERSON has acted in a manner contrary to his trust as president and subversive of constitutional government to the great prejudice of the cause of law and justice and to the manifest injury of the people of GPE. Whereas or wherefore, President PERSON by such conduct has demonstrated that he will remain a threat to the constitution if allowed to remain in office and has acted in a manner grossly incompatible with self government and the rule of law. President PERSON thus warrants impeachment and trial, removal from office and disqualification to hold and enjoy any office of honor, trust, or profit under GPE. Let me say something about this second article. The facts of the president's defiance of ORG are very simple because they were so uniform. Because they are so uncontested, but too do not mistake for a moment the fact that it was simple and easy and quick to present that course of conduct compared with a sophisticated campaign to coerce GPE into thinking that that second article is any less significant than the first. If there is no article CARDINAL, let me tell you something, there will never be an article CARDINAL. Because if you and we lack the power to investigate a president, there will never be an article CARDINAL. Whether that article CARDINAL is abuse of power or that article CARDINAL is treason or that article CARDINAL is bribery, there will never be an article CARDINAL if the ORG cannot investigate an impeachable offense. text: God willing, our relationship with GPE will survive and GPE will prosper and we will get beyond this ugly chapter of our history. If a president can simply say, I am going to fight all subpoenas, and I will tell you something else. Truism in the courts is just as true here in the ORG where they say justice delayed is justice denied. You give this president or any other the unilateral power to delay as long as he or she likes, to litigate matters for DATE and DATE in the courts and do not fool yourself into thinking it is anything less. text: So when you suggest or I suggest or anyone suggests or ORG suggest, why does not the ORG, why did not the ORG just exhaust their remedies as if in the constitution where it says, The ORG shall have the sole power of impeachment. text: CARDINAL of the things that we in this fellowship of office holders understand that most people do not is that real political courage does not come from disagreeing with our opponents but from disagreeing with our friends and with our own party, because it means having to stare down accusations of disloyalty and betrayal. He is a NORP name only or she is a NORP in name only. What I said TIME, if it resonated with anyone in this chamber, did not require courage. My views, as heartfelt as they are, reflect the views of my constituents. But what happens when our heartfelt views of right and wrong are in conflict with the popular opinion of our constituents? What happens when our devotion to our oaths, to our values, to our love of country, depart from the momentary passion of a large number of people back home? Those are the times that try our souls. ORG news reported last night that a PERSON confidante said that ORG senators were warned, Vote against your president, vote against the president and your head will be on a pike. Vote against the president and your head will be on a pike. I have to say, when I read that, and again, I do not know if that is true, but when I read that I was struck by the irony. But I was struck by the irony of the idea when we are talking about a president who would make himself a monarch, that whoever that was would use the terminology of a penalty that was opposed by a monarch. DATE, GPE lost a hero, PERSON. He passed away on DATE, DATE before this trial began. Some of you may have known or even served with congressman PERSON, he was a NORP from GPE and a second ranking member on the ORG judiciary committee when that committee was conducting its impeachment inquiry into President PERSON. Here in the ORG, they might have called them the gang of CARDINAL. text: Some say that the PERSON impeachment might not have moved forward were it not for those CARDINAL courageous NORP led by Congressman PERSON and it pained the congressman because he credited PERSON with giving him his seat, with getting him elected. Not as I said at the outset, between guilt and innocence, but a far more foundational issue. To the degree that even superficially a claim would attach, it does not conceal misconduct. What is more, to the degree that there were a dispute over whether a privilege applied, we have a perfectly good judge sitting behind me, empowered by the rules of this body to resolve those disputes. text: Are the blessings of freedom so meager that we will not endure the fatigue of a real trial with witnesses and documents. President PERSON in his closing message to congress in DATE said this, Fellow citizens we cannot escape history. We of this ORG and this administration will be remembered in spite of ourselves. No personal significance or insignificance can spare CARDINAL or another of us the fiery trial through which we pass will light us down in honor or dishonor to the latest generation. This man who started out dirt poor, dirt poor like CARDINAL of other people at the time, he had nothing. No money, no education, he educated himself. I believe this may be CARDINAL of those moments. A moment when our democracy was gravely threatened and not from without but from within. GPE too has a constitution. text: FAC complex-that is what they call these buildings. Makes you wonder, cannot anything in GPE ever be simple? text: I hope I can count on your support on something else as well, and it is the principal reason that we are here DATE. Judge PERSON. Judge PERSON has been on my short list from the very start. A graduate of ORG and ORG, he has served DATE on ORG. There he won the respect of his fellow jurists and the lawyers who practice before that court. He participated in CARDINAL decisions and wrote CARDINAL opinions. He earned the reputation for being a balanced and fair judge and one who is tough on crime and concerned about the victims of crime. Victims' dissatisfaction with the criminal justice system represents a failure of the system to achieve its goals. The significant criminal law decisions of ORG focused on the relation of the accused to the state, and the police as an instrument of the state. Little or no thought was given to the position of the victims. Well, that is a note of compassion and realism that is too often missing in our courts. Realism runs through all his work on the bench. He argued in CARDINAL dissent, for example, for a good faith exception to the exclusionary rule, and saw his position ultimately adopted by ORG. That was in a drug case, by the way. And for realism about police work, the opinion he wrote in that case sets a high standard. You do not have to read many cases involving illegal drug traffic before it becomes clear exactly what was going on at the residences described by the officer's affidavit. Whatever the merits of the exclusionary rule, its rigidities become compounded unacceptably when courts presume innocent conduct when the only commonsense explanation for it is ongoing criminal activity. Another example of his realism-DATE Judge PERSON upheld a lower court when it imposed the maximum sentence allowed by law against a child pornographer. His opinion focused on the severe psychological harm victims of child pornography endure and the great likelihood that child pornographers will, when released, commit the same crimes again. We need more realism like that on the Nation's highest court. We need Judge PERSON on our highest court. But let me add another thought here. The Constitution itself is tough on crime; it was intended to establish justice and ensure domestic tranquility. It provides a system for discovering the truth, releasing the innocent, and punishing the guilty, not for subjecting the police to an endless guessing game about the rules.

text: And thank you for your principled leadership-both in government, where we worked together so closely, and now at ORG. I want to commend you and your colleagues here for the many contributions you make to our national security discourse-including on the challenge that brings us together DATE. In response to PERSON barbaric use of chemical weapons against the NORP people, President PERSON, after careful consideration, has decided that it is in the national security interest of GPE to conduct limited military strikes against the NORP regime. President PERSON has asked ORG for its support in this action, because in a democracy, our policies are stronger, more effective and more sustainable when they have the support of the NORP people and their elected leaders. DATE TIME, the President will address the nation and make his case for taking action. DATE, I want to take this opportunity to explain why GPE's use of chemical weapons is a serious threat to our national security, and why it is in our national interest to undertake limited military action to deter future use. There is no denying what happened on DATE, while most of GPE was still asleep, PERSON's forces loaded warheads filled with deadly chemicals onto rockets and launched them into suburbs controlled or contested by opposition forces. They unleashed hellish chaos and terror on a massive scale. Innocent civilians were jolted awake, choking on poison. In the end, CARDINAL were dead-CARDINAL of them children. In DATE, we have been shocked by the videos from GPE and other neighborhoods near GPE. As a parent, I cannot look at those pictures-those little children laying on the ground, their eyes glassy, their bodies twitching-and not think of my own CARDINAL kids. I can only imagine the agony of those parents in GPE. Sarin targets the body's central nervous system, making every breath a struggle and causing foaming at the nose and mouth, intense nausea and uncontrollable convulsions. The death of any innocent, in GPE or around the world, is a tragedy, whether by bullet or landmine or poisonous gas. Gas plumes shift and spread without warning. The masses of people they can fell are immense. Chemical weapons, like other weapons of mass destruction, kill on a scope and scale that is entirely different from conventional weapons. There is no doubt about who is responsible for this attack.

text: The NORP regime possesses CARDINAL of the largest stockpiles of chemical weapons in the world. PERSON has been struggling to clear these very neighborhoods in GPE and drive out the opposition, but his conventional arsenal was not working well enough or fast enough. Only the NORP regime has the capacity to deliver chemical weapons on a scale to cause the devastation we saw in GPE. The rockets were fired from territory controlled by the regime. The rockets landed in territory controlled or contested by the opposition. And the intelligence we have gathered reveals senior officials planning the attack and then, afterwards, plotting to cover up the evidence by destroying the area with shelling. Of course, this is not the first time that PERSON has used chemical weapons in this conflict; we assess that he has used them on a small-scale multiple times since DATE. Whereas previous attacks each killed relatively few people, this one murdered CARDINAL in CARDINAL fell swoop. PERSON is lowering his threshold for use while increasing exponentially the lethality of his attacks. PERSON's escalating use of chemical weapons threatens the national security of GPE. And the likelihood that, left unchecked, PERSON will continue to use these weapons again and again takes the NORP conflict to an entirely new level-by terrorizing civilians, creating even greater refugee flows, and raising the risk that deadly chemicals would spill across borders into neighboring GPE, GPE, GPE, and GPE. text: It is better to let them reconstruct themselves than to force them to it; for if they go wrong, the power is in our hands and we can check them at any stage, to the end, and oblige them to correct their errors.
